pages.name: Benoni Defense: Franco-Sicilian Hybrid
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed f2-f4 through the f3-knight; plan 3 rerouted the e7-knight via c8-b6 or g8-f6; plan 4 called White's own d5-pawn an outpost. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Englund Gambit: Soller Gambit Deferred
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured ...Nxf6 before White had taken on f6; plan 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plan 1, fixed plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Mikenas Defense: Lithuanian Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked a d5-e4 chain before White has played e4; overview named ...f6 as the break (it is ...f5). Rewrote overview and plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Modern Defense: Lizard Defense, Pirc-Diemer Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 suggested Rg1 for an h-file attack and Ng5 with no knight able to reach it. Rewrote plans 1-2 around ...Nxh5, e4, Be2 and the half-open h-file; British spelling.

pages.name: Pterodactyl Defense: Fianchetto, Queen Benoni Pterodactyl
pages.notes: Plan 1 named White's Bd2 and Qc2 inside a Black plan. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Anglo-Slav Opening
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the pawn triangle as a move (c6-d6-e6) and put the light-squared bishop on b7 without ...b6. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: English Defence, 3.a3
pages.notes: Plan 3 offered d3 and Be2 with the d-pawn on d4 and the e-pawn on e2. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: Modern
pages.notes: Plan 1 named d4-d5 inside a Black plan. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: Modern
pages.notes: Plan 1 named d4-d5 inside a Black plan; plan 3 and the overview suggested a Hedgehog that does not fit the g6/c5 set-up. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Rossolimo Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 named gxf3 and Qxf3 before Black had taken on f3; plan 1 assumed gxf3. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.
